title: Switch commands
intro: Run a saved command on one or many switches and read the answers side by side. Show commands only read; commands that change something are for leads and ask twice.
noPlugin: No plugin that can run switch commands is on. An admin turns on SSH port actions under Settings > Plugins.
passwordHint: Used for this run only, never stored.

kindHint.show: Each command has to start with show, display, ping, traceroute or get. Techs can run it.
kindHint.change: Only leads and admins can run it, and they confirm it a second time.

confirmTitle: Run a command that changes something?
confirmText_one: "{{label}}" changes something on {{count}} switch. It is logged with your name.
confirmText_other: "{{label}}" changes something on {{count}} switches. It is logged with your name.
label: Name
commandsHint: One per line. {port} is the port the crew types.
